target.class_name: Anh văn chuyên ngành Cơ khí
target.lesson_title: Chapter 5: Mechanical Fasteners — Chi tiết kẹp chặt (chốt nối cơ khí)

exam.title: Kiểm tra từ vựng Chapter 5: Mechanical Fasteners

questions.question: Which English word means “đinh tán”?
questions.explanation: rivet: A permanent fastener that cannot be unscrewed.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
In the direction of clock hands; a nut is screwed on this way.
questions.explanation: clockwise = theo chiều kim đồng hồ.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A device used to hold two or more things together.
questions.explanation: fastener = chốt nối, chi tiết kẹp chặt (vít, bu lông, đinh…).

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A fastener with a thread that is turned into a surface.
questions.explanation: screw = đinh vít, vít.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A hand tool that tightens and loosens nuts and bolts.
questions.explanation: spanner = cờ lê.

questions.question: Which English word means “chìa lục giác”?
questions.explanation: hex key / Allen key: An L-shaped tool that fits into a socket head.

questions.question: Which English word means “đai ốc, con tán”?
questions.explanation: nut: A piece of metal with a hole in the middle.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
The helical grooves on the outside of a bolt or screw.
questions.explanation: thread = ren.

questions.question: What does groove mean?
options: đầu tán (tạo ra khi tán ở xưởng)
đầu có sẵn của đinh tán (đầu nhà máy)
questions.explanation: groove = rãnh.

questions.question: Which English word means “đầu lục giác chìm”?
questions.explanation: socket head: A bolt head with a hexagonal hole in its top.

questions.question: Which English word means “cấp bền của bu lông”?
questions.explanation: grade: The measurement of a bolt's strength.

questions.question: What does sheet metal screw mean?
options: đầu tán (tạo ra khi tán ở xưởng)
ren phải (vặn vào theo chiều kim đồng hồ)
vít tôn, vít tự ren (ren suốt thân, bắt được cả gỗ và kim loại)
questions.explanation: sheet metal screw = vít tôn, vít tự ren (ren suốt thân, bắt được cả gỗ và kim loại).

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A flat ring placed between the nut and the surface.
questions.explanation: washer = vòng đệm, long đền.

questions.question: What does wood screw mean?
options: ren phải (vặn vào theo chiều kim đồng hồ)
questions.explanation: wood screw = vít gỗ.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A bolt head with six sides, turned by a spanner.
questions.explanation: hex head = đầu lục giác.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A hollow rivet fitted with a rivet gun.
questions.explanation: blind rivet = đinh tán rút, đinh rive.

questions.question: Which English word means “bu lông”?
questions.explanation: bolt: A threaded fastener used with a nut to press pieces together.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A device that tightly presses things together.
questions.explanation: clamp = cái kẹp, vam kẹp.

questions.question: What does temporary / permanent mean?
options: ren phải (vặn vào theo chiều kim đồng hồ)
vít tôn, vít tự ren (ren suốt thân, bắt được cả gỗ và kim loại)
đầu tán (tạo ra khi tán ở xưởng)
questions.explanation: temporary / permanent = tạm thời / vĩnh viễn.

questions.question: Which English word means “cái đinh”?
questions.explanation: nail: A long, narrow fastener with a smooth rod.

questions.question: Which English word means “tắc kê, nở”?
questions.explanation: anchor: A device that adds support to a screw.

questions.question: Which English word means “kìm rút đinh tán, súng bắn rive”?
questions.explanation: rivet gun: A tool used for installing blind rivets.

questions.question: What does helical mean?
questions.explanation: helical = xoắn ốc.

questions.question: Which English word means “ren hệ mét”?
questions.explanation: metric thread: A thread measured in millimeters.

questions.question:
Which word matches this definition?
A small, simple fastener used for temporary jobs.
questions.explanation: pin = chốt, ghim.
